niche: a joint regional park authority in England apportioning its 2027-28 levy among its nine member councils by the number of each council's adult residents who visited its parks in the 2025-26 survey year, each counted once, estimated from an on-site exit survey that draws adults as they leave on sampled days
answer: Charge the 2027-28 levy of £7,416,300 as Keldmere District Council £1,250,310, Ravenwick Borough Council £1,525,314, Snelgarth District Council £977,169, Larkstead Borough Council £717,236, Grinbury District Council £743,901, Hornmere District Council £650,135, Chaldale District Council £549,836, Wendstow District Council £513,321 and Ferncote Borough Council £489,078, resting on 271,900 adult residents who visited in 2025-26 (the valley councils 50.6 per cent)
stakeholder_role: the Authority's head of finance, who takes the 2027-28 levy apportionment to the Authority's members at the January 2027 budget meeting

spine.file: dvrpa_visitor_survey_2025-26_wave1.xlsx and dvrpa_visitor_survey_2025-26_wave2.csv (two contractor deliveries) with survey_weights_2025-26.csv
spine.entity: one interview with one adult leaving one of the Authority's parks on a sampled survey day

world.geography: England (an unnamed county; the Authority, its parks, its nine member councils, their towns and villages and the survey contractor are fictional; personas on the en_GB index)
world.org_type: a statutory joint regional park authority funded by a levy on its member councils

driver: The decisive quantity is how many different members of each group a population of repeated events contains, seen only through a sample of the events in which each member is drawn in proportion to how many events it makes; reading the sampled members as the members, or dividing each group's estimated events by its sampled members' average event count, gives the groups whose members repeat most too many or too few, and only weighting each sampled member by its design weight over its own event count counts them.
driver_concrete: The levy follows each member council's adults who visited the parks at least once in 2025-26, each counted once, but the exit survey draws adults as they leave on sampled days, so a resident who walks the dog in Brathden every morning is about two hundred times as likely to be interviewed as one who came twice; the valley councils' residents are the frequent visitors, so apportioning by expanded visits, or by visits divided by each council's respondents' average 12-month visit count, puts the valley councils' share far off the share the survey's own weights over each respondent's visit count give.
stump: A competent solver expands the interviews by the contractor's weights, sums them by home council and turns each council's visits into residents by dividing by its respondents' average 12-month visit count, a visit-weighted average that overstates how often each council's residents come, so the valley councils' residents are undercounted and their levy shares fall well below the shares the design weight over each respondent's own visit count gives.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who codes every frequency answer, places every respondent in a council through the gazetteer, reads the members' resolution correctly (residents aged 16 and over who visited, each counted once) and expands the interviews by the contractor's weights still divides each council's estimated visits by its respondents' average number of visits and files a levy split that undercharges the three valley councils, because an exit survey draws each resident in proportion to how often they come, so the respondents' average is a visit-weighted average; only each interview's weight over its own visit count counts residents.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a population total (each council's distinct adult residents who visited) estimated from a probability sample of visits by the survey-design estimator that weights every sampled unit by the inverse of its inclusion probability, which an exit survey makes proportional to the person's visits; that is the sample-design task type's own object, and with another field's nouns the intercept design, the expansion strata and the visit-count question that set each person's chance of selection have nothing to attach to.

differentiation.task264: architecture 1 decided the unit at which a price is followed, a definitional choice; architecture 2 turns a probability sample of visits into a count of people by inverse inclusion probability, with the unit (residents, each once) filed literally
differentiation.task452: task452 weights reference points by the strata they were drawn from after the map was revised; task264 turns an equal-chance sample of visits into people, each weighted by the inverse of their own visit count, a selection the design makes proportional to frequency
differentiation.task253: task253 counts units past a floor as a sum of probabilities under shrinkage; task264's inverse-frequency weight comes from the sampling design, not from noise in a measurement
differentiation.task131: task131 v1 reads a randomised lift at the parent unit because sub-units share one budget; task264 turns an exit survey's sample of visits, drawn in proportion to each person's visits, into a count of people
differentiation.task136: task136 forecasts a bulk-buy's net addition of rooftop PV against suburbs whose campaign had not yet run; task264 estimates a count of people from an exit survey's sample of visits, each interview weighted by the inverse of its own visit count; guard surface pairs them only on card axes (population_selection, method_or_model_selection, a council)

lineage.driver: The decisive unit is the one that sets the value: averaging records across setters lets volume moving between dearer and cheaper setters pass for a change in the value, and splitting one setter's single value across its outlets keeps only the outlet-periods with a transaction, so the comparisons lose the slowly traded items and follow the busy ones.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a grocery scanner price index's 2027 publication structure: each category's change in four store formats, each line followed at the chain that prices it)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-17: the first determinism pass found the call deterministic (FIX_NOW on four ask forks); the one re-judge returned SEND_BACK (competing_defensible_answer): the methodology never says what a product is, so a literal reader prices each line store by store (7 categories) and the golden's line at its chain (10) holds only under an unfiled product definition; filing it would make the decisive step rule application
